help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Everything Dosye can do, in a few minutes
help.intro: Dosye creates folder icons. Pick a shape, paint it, add an image and export a .ico (Windows) or .png (Linux, macOS, web). Every change shows up instantly in the preview and in the real icon sizes below it.
help.start.title: Getting started
help.start.body: 1. Choose a shape on the left. 2. Set the fill and effects on the right. 3. Click Export icon (.ico) or Apply icon to a folder. Not inspired? Press Surprise me.
help.shapes.title: Shapes
help.shapes.body: There are 51 shapes in six categories. Use the category buttons or type in the search box (accents optional). Thumbnails always use your current colours.
help.fill.title: Colour, gradient and cover
help.fill.body: Colour / gradient paints the folder with one or two colours (right-click a palette swatch to set the second colour). Image (cover) uses any photo or texture: apply it to the whole folder or only the front, choose Fill, Fit or Tile, then zoom, move (drag in the preview), tint and blend it with the colour.
help.png.title: PNG image: coming out or emblem
help.png.body: Load a PNG (or drop it on the preview). Coming out places it between the back and the front, as if it were peeking out of the folder. Emblem prints it on the front with original colours, embossed or as a white silhouette. Drag it in the preview and use the mouse wheel to resize; hold Shift to switch between the PNG and the cover.
help.effects.title: Light, shadow and details
help.effects.body: Adjust light intensity and direction, gloss, outer glow, drop shadow, inner shading, papers inside, frosted glass front, outline and the mirrored (right-side) tab. Everything works with every shape.
help.export.title: Export
help.export.body: Export icon (.ico) writes one file with several sizes (16 to 256 px — choose them in Settings). Export PNG saves 256, 512 or 1024 px images with transparency.
help.folder.title: Apply the icon to a folder
help.folder.body: Windows: Dosye writes a hidden icon and a desktop.ini inside the folder; press F5 if Explorer doesn't refresh. Linux: Dosye stores a hidden PNG in the folder and sets it for GNOME Files, Nemo and Caja (GIO metadata) and for KDE Dolphin (.directory). Other file managers may not support custom folder icons. Remove icon from a folder undoes everything.
help.presets.title: Presets
help.presets.body: Save stores your design as a .dosye.json file with the images embedded, so it works on any computer. Open also reads presets from Gerador de Pastas (.pasta.json). You can drop a preset on the preview too.
